conditions: Ghost (x1) tier pays 7,500 credits, 30 Fieldron Samples, 300 Plastids, 2,250 Salvage and 10 Control Modules for the Cyanex research; bigger clans pay x3, x10, x30 or x100.
In an established clan this is already done and costs you nothing.

rows.label: Cyanex Blueprint
rows.note: 15,000 cr, not sold in the Market

rows.label: Fieldron
rows.alt: or craft from Fieldron Samples, 12h each

conditions: Crafting Fieldron means several 12-hour builds before the 12-hour Cyanex build can start, so start this first.
bonuses: Fieldron also drops from rare and reinforced Corpus storage containers and some Orb Vallis bounty stages.

disclosures.title: crafting from scratch
disclosures.body: Each Fieldron is an Energy Lab craft: 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Samples, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids, 12 hours. All 5 cost 50 Fieldron Samples and 75,000 credits. Samples drop from Corpus enemies.

rows.label: Hexenon
rows.alt: or Io, Jupiter defense, for lower-level accounts

conditions: Hexenon has no mining deposit and can't be bought; it's a Jupiter mission drop only.
bonuses: A loot frame (Nekros Desecrate, Khora Strangledome, Hydroid Pilfering Swarm) and resource boosters both apply to Hexenon pickups.
Distilling Extractors on Jupiter give 60-80 Hexenon about a third of the time per 8-hour run.

disclosures.title: skip the Dark Sectors
disclosures.body: Reddit recommends Cameria and Sinai for the +20% resource bonus, but the wiki notes they dropped less Hexenon than normal Jupiter missions in testing. Disruption is the better pick.

rows.label: Cyanex
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 5 Fieldron, 8,750 Nano Spores, 250 Hexenon, 1 Forma
